Uncle Sam's Intel
Stake: -$11B on Paper

lines.text: The government's Intel stake lost over $11 billion on paper Friday.
lines.say: The government's Intel stake lost over eleven billion dollars on paper Friday.

lines.text: Intel shares fell about 29% Friday, their worst day since 1974, the AP reports.
lines.say: Intel shares fell about twenty-nine percent Friday, their worst day since nineteen seventy-four, the A P reports.

lines.text: Intel guided fourth-quarter sales to $15 to $16 billion, below the roughly $17 billion expected.
lines.say: Intel guided fourth-quarter sales to fifteen to sixteen billion dollars, below the roughly seventeen billion expected.

lines.text: Why care? In August 2025, the government took about 10% of Intel at $20.47 a share.
lines.say: Why care? In August twenty twenty-five, the government took about ten percent of Intel at twenty dollars and forty-seven cents a share.

lines.text: Thursday the stock closed at $92.07. Friday, $65.76.
lines.say: Thursday the stock closed near ninety-two dollars. Friday, near sixty-six.

lines.text: By our math, that's about $11.4 billion gone, on paper.
lines.say: By our math, that's about eleven point four billion dollars gone, on paper.

lines.text: Still, the stake is worth about $28.5 billion, over 3 times its $8.9 billion cost.
lines.say: Still, the stake is worth about twenty-eight and a half billion, over three times its eight point nine billion cost.

lines.text: The takeaway: one stock fell 29%. The S&P 500, holding 500 companies, fell 1.8%.
lines.say: The takeaway: one stock fell twenty-nine percent. The S and P five hundred, holding five hundred companies, fell one point eight percent.

lines.text: That's the money. Follow for more.

post.title: Uncle Sam's Intel stake lost $11B+ on paper in one day
post.ig:
The government's Intel stake lost over $11 billion on paper in one day.
Intel fell about 29% on Friday, Oct 30, its worst day since 1974, after guiding fourth-quarter sales to $15B-$16B vs about $17B expected.
The US took about 10% of Intel (433.3M shares at $20.47) in August 2025. By our math, Friday's drop cut that stake by about $11.4B on paper; it is still worth about $28.5B, over 3x its $8.9B cost.
Same day, the S&P 500 fell 1.8%.
Sources: CNBC, Yahoo Finance, AP (Oct 30, 2026); Intel Q3 2026 release (Oct 29, 2026).
